description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Castlegar BC is a budget motel chain property situated in Castlegar, a small city at the confluence of the Columbia and Kootenay rivers in the BC interior. It sits along 18th Street, a main commercial corridor that gives touring cyclists straightforward access to services. As a branded Wyndham property it participates in the Wyndham Rewards program, which may appeal to cyclists doing multi-night tours across the region.

However, all fetched subpages return only navigation boilerplate and booking UI — no property-specific amenity details are present, so all cyclist-relevant criteria must be null.
